typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchivePath as string (),
	CallList_Code as string (),
	ErrorEmailMessage as string (),
	ErrorEmailRecipients as string (),
	FileExtension as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	QuarantineFile as string (),
	QuarantineFileName as string (),
	QuarantinePath as string (),
	vMemberNoMatchCount as integer (),
	vMemberNoMatchEmailMessage as string (),
	vMemberNoMatchEmailRecipients as string (),
	vMemberNoMatchExportFile as string (),
	vMemberNoMatchExportFileName as string (),
	vMemberNoMatchExportFolder as string ()
}

source(output(
		MemberNum as string,
		Phone as string,
		CustomUse as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(FileIID = $File_IID) ~> AddFileId
AddFileId derive(MemberNum_NonUnicode = MemberNum,
		Phone_NonUnicode = Phone) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID as long,
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_MEMBERPHONE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID = FileIID,
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = MemberNum_NonUnicode,
		MEMBERLIST_STAGING_MEMBERPHONE = Phone_NonUnicode)) ~> OLEDBDestination
